boundary: Manual-backed declarations, full subscripts, named-component prefixes and reference passing, with explicit offline storage/copy/allocation policies. Tests prove prototype behavior only. No fresh compiler run, controller execution or storage-layout authentication.

rules.documented: Arrays may contain any data type except PATH; structures use previously declared named types. Named identity and existing reference/array rules apply.
rules.implemented: Fixed 1D/2D/3D arrays of prior named structures in global, routine-local and structure-field declarations; full indexed field paths; nominal type/rank-matched ARRAY formals; element STRUCTURE references and scalar/array field references. ARRAY_LEN counts elements of one-dimensional arrays without reading their fields.
rules.restriction: Whole array/element/structure copies require identical concrete types/shapes and fully initialized known scalar leaves when structures are copied. Deep copies preserve destination element and nested-field storage identities. Partially initialized or unknown-BYTE copies fail before destination mutation. These copy/alias policies are prototype choices, not controller observations. The 32767 scalar-leaf allocation guard includes nested structure and array fields. Whole ARRAY value arguments, aggregate UNINIT, unnamed-group prefixes and multidimensional ARRAY_LEN remain blocked. Named ARRAY components with structure leaves are supported as recorded in subarray_semantics.json.

rules.feature: Fixed two- and three-dimensional scalar arrays
rules.implemented: Comma-separated fixed dimensions in global, routine-local and STRUCTURE-field declarations. INTEGER, BOOLEAN, exact REAL, bounded ASCII STRING and BYTE/SHORT scalar elements. Each dimension is a constant INTEGER in 1..32767. Narrow storage/value rules are recorded separately in narrow_integer_semantics.json.
rules.restriction: Total scalar leaves are capped at 32767 by an explicit prototype allocation guard, including nested fields when the elements are structures. This is not a claimed KAREL total-size limit. Fixed named ARRAY definitions are supported with nominal identity, as recorded in named_array_semantics.json. Variable-sized declarations outside the explicit global specialization subset, inline anonymous nested ARRAY type syntax and aliases to existing type names remain blocked.

rules.feature: Full comma-separated subscripts and named ARRAY component prefixes
rules.implemented: Each dimension group requires all its indexes; a prefix may stop before a separately named ARRAY component. All indexes are one-based and checked independently. Reads, writes, scalar UNINIT and reference/value arguments use the selected type and capacity. Captured indexes are not recomputed after callee writes. Named subarrays retain nominal identity for copying and reference passing.
rules.restriction: Prefixes within unnamed dimension groups and chained brackets remain blocked. Multiple subscripts containing a user routine call are blocked until evaluation order is established; assignment-target and effectful indexed-result guards are retained.
rules.tests: tests/test_multidimensional_arrays.py: ElementTests, ReferenceTests and BoundaryTests; tests/test_subarrays.py

rules.implemented: ARRAY[*], ARRAY[*,*] and ARRAY[*,*,*] formals retain caller shape and scalar element type; ARRAY OF a supported scalar type remains the one-dimensional form. STRING element capacity is inherited from caller storage. Whole-array forwarding and element aliasing retain their existing reference rules. BYTE/SHORT scalar arguments to INTEGER/REAL formals use value copies, as recorded in narrow_integer_semantics.json. Generic scalar/STRUCTURE interfaces match total logical rank across named ARRAY components. ARRAY OF a prior named ARRAY component retains and checks that component identity. Reference binding keeps actual caller storage without flattening it.
rules.restriction: Total logical rank must match exactly and cannot exceed three. Fixed formal dimensions and whole-array value passing remain blocked. Restricted internal ARRAY results follow array_routine_semantics.json. Formal wildcards inherit caller storage. Separate explicit translation context is required for global wildcard declarations; routine-local wildcard declarations remain blocked.

rules.feature: Whole-array copy and existing element references
rules.implemented: Whole copies require identical complete concrete definitions, including shapes, element types, STRING capacity and every nominal named ARRAY identity. Copies are independent and may contain uninitialized scalar-only leaves. Destination row, plane, element and field storage remains stable across self-copy, formal assignment and containing aggregate copies.
rules.restriction: Fixed mismatches fail conversion; unknown formal shapes/capacities are checked at runtime before destination mutation. Every copied STRUCTURE leaf, including below nested ARRAY components, retains the complete-initialization/known-BYTE guard. Flat-to-nested or nested-to-flat concrete copy coercion is blocked. Internal component storage and snapshot lists are prototype choices without controller-layout authentication.

rules.implemented: ARRAY_LEN retains its existing one-logical-dimension behavior. UNINIT accepts supported scalar elements, including fully subscripted multidimensional elements and SHORT markers; BYTE initialization queries remain blocked.
rules.restriction: ARRAY_LEN on a multidimensional array is rejected with E_ARRAY_LEN because the inspected entry does not disambiguate outer-dimension count from total scalar count. Pass explicit dimension counts to routines. The manual prohibits UNINIT on an unsubscripted ARRAY or STRUCTURE.

data_record_update.policy: Fixed/named arrays and exact-type generic array formals accept these records. Logical rank and leaf-count limits remain; whole copies require every record leaf initialized, and CONFIG turn ranges are rechecked.

position_update.boundary: POSITION array elements retain read-only orientation descendants through copies; full copies still require initialized leaves. XYZWPREXT arrays include all three extra REAL axes.

joint_update.boundary: Fixed/named JOINTPOS arrays and exact-width formals; initialized whole copies; axis values count toward leaf limits.

variable_array_update.boundary: Direct global wildcard ARRAY declarations may be specialized using explicit positive array_shapes translation context. TYPE/field/local wildcards, inferred storage and runtime resizing remain blocked; existing guards retained.

structure_routine_update.boundary: Prior exact named STRUCTURE results and independent writable value copies are supported with full recursive initialization/type/capacity guards. Whole ARRAY values and controller behavior remain blocked; restricted results use array_routine_semantics.json; exact positional copies are covered in positional_routine_semantics.json.

array_routine_update.boundary: Internal unsized anonymous outer ARRAY results with supported scalar, explicitly bounded STRING, record, exact-width joint or prior named fixed ARRAY elements, one outer dimension and at most three logical dimensions. Independent recursively checked copies and direct assignment only; all scalar leaves known/initialized. Exact STRING element capacities retained and checked without result truncation. Named outer results, flat multidimensional result sources/declarations, unspecified STRING capacities, direct STRING returns and whole ARRAY value arguments remain blocked.
